notes.title: The release of "The story of Bill Bear" in early access is very close!
notes.notes:
As planned, it will take place on December 10 – no postponements, no lags, no excuses.
Voiceover of all dialogues has been added to the game. We think it turned out great. Be sure to write in the comments as you like. 
Before the release, we ourselves play a lot of "The story of Bill Bear". We went through the game more than once and came up with another achievement. So with this update, another, now the most secret, achievement has appeared in the game.
We are waiting for everyone at the release!
